summary_en: Sekisui House announced a tender offer for all shares and warrants of Gifu Zouen at 2,770 yen per share and 397,800 yen per warrant, with a minimum tender threshold of 1,529,300 shares (46.67% of fully diluted shares) representing 67.40% ownership post-closing, with the tender period from November 16, 2026 to January 13, 2027.
title_en: Notice of Commencement of Tender Offer for Gifu Zouen Co., Ltd. (Securities Code: 1438)
translation_en_brief:
Sekisui House, the leading shareholder of Gifu Zouen with a 20.00% stake, announced on November 13, 2026 the commencement of a tender offer to acquire all remaining shares and warrants of the target company. The offer price is set at 2,770 yen per ordinary share and 397,800 yen per warrant. The minimum tender threshold is 1,529,300 shares, which would result in Sekisui House owning 67.40% of Gifu Zouen's total voting rights following the closing. There is no upper limit on the number of shares to be acquired, as the offeror intends to make Gifu Zouen a wholly owned subsidiary.

The tender offer period runs for 37 business days from November 16, 2026 to January 13, 2027. If the total number of tendered securities falls below the minimum threshold of 1,529,300 shares, the offeror will not proceed with any purchases. Conversely, if tendered securities meet or exceed the minimum threshold, the offeror commits to purchasing all tendered shares and warrants to achieve complete ownership. The minimum threshold is calculated to ensure Sekisui House attains two-thirds of voting rights, which is necessary for conducting a stock consolidation under the Companies Act as a subsequent step to forcibly acquire remaining minority shares.

Gifu Zouen is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Standard Market and Nagoya Stock Exchange Main Market. Sekisui House currently accounts Gifu Zouen as an equity method affiliate. The target company's board of directors has endorsed the tender offer and recommended that shareholders and warrant holders participate.
